name: flow
description: Ambient scenes above the prompt that move with your agent's work: a fire, a river, bubbles, a liquid lamp, surf, ski, rockets, a hot-air balloon and more, by day or night. /flow to control it.

mode.title: Scene mode
mode.description: auto moves with Claude's work; manual holds the level below

style.title: Scene
style.description: fire: a ░▒▓█ fire with sparks and smoke; warp: stars that speed up to hyperspace; colony: a colony ship whose shield burns up the asteroids that hit it; balloon: a hot-air balloon that climbs from the grass to space; engine: a steampunk engine that runs up to full speed; falcon / starship: rockets that launch from the pad and are caught by the tower on the way down; surf: a surfer and the swell; ski: a skier down the mountain; river: a river running past; bubbles: bubbles fizzing up; lava: liquid churning in a lamp

idle.title: Scene while idle
idle.description: Auto mode while Claude is idle: a low glow, or dark (the band gives its rows back)

layout.title: Scene layout
layout.description: band: a strip above the prompt; spine: a tall pane docked beside the transcript (fullscreen)

level.title: Manual level
level.description: Manual mode's level: 0 (off) to 10 (the busiest the scene gets)

time.title: Day or night
time.description: For balloon, falcon, starship, surf, ski, river and bubbles: clock follows your local time (night from 19:00 to 7:00); day or night pins it
